M-S4d-rows1-21-single-page-listings-190r.objective: M9 S4d on 1.9.0rc4 (8abc2c1): progressive coverage of rows 0-21 within what is left of the approval: the 30 listings of rows 1-21 that the census of 2026-11-02 measured at 24 products or fewer (one page each, 286 products) and that no 1.8 or 1.9 run has collected (INCOMPLETE_QUEUE after S3b). Hard Cider 08194 (6 products) is left out: its seed URL has no slash before its ID. One page each, so the repeat of later pages cannot stop them unless a listing has grown past 24. Measured: how many listings complete; the tile on more departments. Not a coverage claim for these rows: each row is narrowed to the listed listings. Known before this stage (O2 2026-11-06; S1b, S4, S5a, S5b and S3 on 1.9.0rc3, 2026-11-09): an unrendered listing answer for ?page=N can carry page 1's products under ranks shifted by 24(N-1), or repeat an earlier page exactly; the collector then ends that listing as incomplete (repeated page). It is intermittent and clustered in time, not tied to a listing: in S4, 8 page-N answers repeated page 1 from 14:33:35Z to 14:36:51Z between distinct ones; in S5a (14:42-14:45Z) the four listings that had repeated in S4 paged, with one repeat (School Office page 4); in S5b (14:51Z) Light Bulbs and School Office repeated again; in S3 (14:57Z) Milk's page 4 repeated an earlier page. S5b's two-lane run on 1.9.0rc3 was rejected by G13: a lane wrote the other lane's page to the database before its answer arrived (6 of 13 listing-page rows); 1.9.0rc4 corrects this.

M-S4d-rows1-21-single-page-listings-190r.retry_policy: the collector's own, as shipped: a listing page up to 3 attempts on 408/429/5xx with backoff (failed requests are documented as not charged; every attempt is still reserved at its worst case); a rendered listing answer without tiles is asked again, three in a row stop the run resumably (PROVIDER_ERROR); the stage is not repeated before its outcome is read
M-S4d-rows1-21-single-page-listings-190r.stop_conditions: the store or PICKUP not verified on a page; the canary failing; a refusal page; 401/402/403 or a quota answer; ABNORMAL_RESULT; the stage's or the collector's ceiling; more than 2 outcomes unknown; lease loss; the key fingerprint differing from the noted one; the deadline
